seo.title: Clara's Day Dive — South Austin Bar & Patio
seo.description: Dive in for a day drink at Clara's Day Dive — a South Austin bar and patio with cocktails, sports, food trucks, morning coffee, and live events.
seo.longDescription: Clara's Day Dive is a South Austin bar and patio at 10700 Menchaca Rd. Coffee in the morning, sports on the screens, cocktails on the patio, and food trucks out back. Open noon to 2am, seven days a week.

responses.What are your hours?: We're open 12pm–2am, seven days a week. Puente Coffee Co opens at 7am every day for morning coffee.
responses.What's on the food truck?: We have a rotating food truck selection — check What's Here on our site to see who's parked out back.
responses.Can I book a private event?: Yes — we'd love to host your event. Head to Plan an event on our site or email events@clarasdaydive.com with the details.
